plain_language.what_did_we_find: The fixed 10,000-vector design, named-variable model, separate auditor and two observer profiles are committed with exact input identities. All 25 focused checks pass. Four earlier prewritten records remain preserved and adopted conditionally; no full corpus or observer result exists at this review.
plain_language.is_it_interesting: Yes as a ready finite comparison: named-variable expectations and separately calculated index operations can expose capture and context-handling differences. This review supplies neither a correctness proof nor an implementation result.
plain_language.does_it_require_more_work: First reproduce and independently audit the four adopted records byte-for-byte, then construct and audit the unchanged full corpus. Observer execution still requires committed corpus/smoke locks, actual-host memory preflight and separate launch review.

findings.committed_inputs: Independently checked both manifests tracked and clean; every scientific, execution-tooling and runtime binding matches current exact bytes. Fourteen Kiota source files additionally match git show at 2d2a9fa31cba31abdd49543c3bb667591207577e.
findings.plan_authority: Immutable source/plan-at-freeze.md is byte-identical to the live item plan at freeze, hash 3bf0354cae3937dd6a1e5993b2f017efc4dca8b1e16c88edeb3a740b96af6fe7. Later live status edits need not reinterpret this bound historical authority.
findings.scope: Exactly 10,000 ordinal-selected vectors: four operation strata, five syntax families, 500 vectors in each combination. Compositions compare intermediate/final results for 15,000 outputs per observer, 30,000 overall. Scope is well-scoped syntax, not typed terms.
findings.independence: Named-model substitution changes free names and alpha-renames binders; lift inserts fresh external-context entries. Independently authored auditor imports neither producer nor model and directly computes index operations after separately translating names. Selection replay repeats the specified rule for custody; shared contract/correlated specification risk remains.
findings.negative_controls: Twenty-five focused tests pass: 12 auditor, five named-model, eight control. Wrong but translation-consistent expectations and capture results reach semantic rejection; malformed index/types, scope/depth errors, cohort/schema errors, altered/duplicate batches and canonical bool-versus-int adoption mismatches fail closed.
findings.adoption: Saved four-record adoption and independent review hashes are checked before freezing. construct() checks committed manifests and this review, regenerates only the four adopted rows, requires canonical byte/SHA identity, audits regenerated rows, and writes a separate replay receipt before full generation. Any mismatch preserves failure and stops full construction.
findings.input_delivery: Generated NDJSON receives independent per-vector/corpus audit. Exact 500-line partition bytes are checked at construction, sealing and launch; input locks must be committed before scientific execution.
findings.observers: Official Lean 4.33.0 Expr.liftLooseBVars/instantiate1 and Kiota 2d2a9fa shift/instantiate1 adapters read input operations and emit full trees without reading expected fields. Kiota clears substitution memos before each vector and retains its structural interner within each fresh batch process.
findings.execution: Manifest fixes 20 batches of 500 vectors per profile, 180-second per-process timeout, 3-GiB sampled RSS ceiling, positive RSS/cleanup requirements and no attempt cap. Exact Lean executable/shared libraries/Expr contract, Python, Cargo, Rust compiler, ps, adapter/source and supervisor bytes are bound.
findings.preparation_limit: One failed Cargo check and successful repair/build are preserved as ordinary unsupervised preparation. Their exact elapsed time and full R1 input binding are unavailable; they are not reported as fully supervised or scientific observer results.
findings.remaining_reviews: Actual full-corpus validity and required capture/cutoff/syntax exposure remain to be checked after generation. Five separate smoke cases/7 outputs already have independently hand-checked expectations, but smoke needs its committed fixture manifest and actual-host RSS before any observer call.

authorized_next_step: Commit this exact review, then run the guarded construction command. Its first required action is unchanged four-record replay and independent audit; only a successful replay permits the fixed full corpus. This review does not authorize an observer launch.
